cli.usage:
Usage: {command} [<command>] [options]

Without a command, {command} starts the guided mode: it looks at where you are and suggests the next step.

Start
  init [app-dir]           creates the documentation project (--dir, --name, --lang, --url, --framework, --auth, --capture, --yes)
  doctor                   checks the environment and the project, with the fix for each problem (--network)
  connect                  opens Chromium on the app: sign in, then press Enter to save the session (--url, --forget)

Screenshots
  capture [patterns…]      takes the screenshots of the capture plans, read-only with a session (--plans, --preview, --no-session)
  record <route>           writes a capture plan entry from what you do in the browser (--id)
  demo                     runs the demo data script (capture.setup)
  inventory                lists what the coverage adapters see (routes, registries…)
  facts                    reads the application code and writes facts/<source>.json (--source, --network, --tools)

Write and review
  dev                      builds, serves and reloads the site while you write (--port)
  new <page-id>            creates a page from a template and adds it to the table of contents (--template, --title, --parent)
  build                    builds the site (--draft, --date YYYY-MM-DD, --output <file>)
  view <page[~anchor]>     screenshots a page of the built site (--theme light|dark, --height, --tour N, --output)
  open [page]              opens the built site in the default browser

Quality
  check [coverage|links|tables|images|secrets|all]   runs the checks (--width <px>, --threshold <KB>)
  audit                    measures the maturity level and lists what to do next (report in the work folder)
  optimize                 recompresses heavy screenshots (--threshold <KB>, --quality <0..1>)
  changes                  what changed in the application since a git reference: routes, tables, variables… (--since)
  stats                    time, tokens and models per block and per version (--by, --since, --csv)

Deliver and maintain
  hooks install            git hooks: facts and sync after each pull and branch switch (uninstall, status)
  export <target>          self-contained copy of the project, engine included (--with-dist, --zip)
  upgrade                  shows the changes since the project's kit version and applies migrations (--apply)
  migrate                  rewrites legacy French-keyed files in the current format
  skill install            installs the Claude Code skill in ~/.claude/skills (--target, --force)

{command} <command> --help (or {command} help <command>) shows the options of a command.
Global options: --project <dir>, --json, --verbose, --lang en|fr, --profile, --help, --version
Exit codes: 0 OK · 1 failed check · 2 usage or configuration · 3 environment
